svg.title: Mahalanobis squared-distance decision in feature space
svg.desc: Two Gaussian class centres share covariance diag(4,1). An illustrative feature moves from (2,1), where minimum squared Mahalanobis distance is 2, to (0,2), where it is 4, crossing a threshold of 3. Dashed ellipses are distance contours and not empirical feature densities.
